system.text:
The cold substance of night runs through their veins, rendering these tormented souls immortal. But it also makes them susceptible to the sun’s burning rays. Orcs suffer +2 Ob to all tests while abroad in the sunlight. If it is cloudy, dawn or twilight, the penalty is only +1 Ob. But the night deadens their nerves as well: Cold Black Blood reduces hesitation obstacles by two for pain, but not fear or wonderment.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Orc common trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 319
